visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young woman wearing a blue-and-white striped shirt and a grey skirt sitting on an outdoor bench. She holds a small yellow envelope with a green heart sticker, looking up with an expectant and joyful facial expression while pink heart-shaped graphics float across the screen. (2) The scene shifts to the girl skipping enthusiastically down an urban sidewalk with green trees and street signage in the background. She continues to hold the envelope close to her chest with both hands, exhibiting high energy and a wide smile as she looks toward the camera. (3) The character enters a large, modern commercial building labeled 'DREAM PLAZA' with glass doors and polished floors. She explores various sections, including a sophisticated chocolate shop called 'CupiCho' featuring Art Deco design, a cafe where she sips red wine, and a brightly lit 7-Eleven themed store. (4) The final phase shows the girl on a rooftop garden with artificial green turf and red curved benches, with a clear view of the Taipei 101 skyscraper in the background. She poses dynamically, eventually crouching on a crosswalk in front of the shopping center while pointing toward the building entrance.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for the 'Dream Plaza' shopping mall in Taipei's Xinyi District. It uses a Valentine's Day (Qixi) theme as a narrative hook to attract couples and young people. By following the protagonist through various high-end shops and scenic spots, the video emphasizes the mall's diverse lifestyle offerings, including dining, shopping, and aesthetic photo locations.
